note: Derived product. Ice shelf outlines traced from the BedMachine floating-ice mask, named by intersection with the MEaSUREs boundaries, then simplified for display. Simplification is relative to each shelf, so the geometry is not at a uniform resolution and is not suitable for measurement. Cite the sources below, not this file.
